import json,os,re
p='store/jobs/j000270/out/coverage-sweep-hit-contexts-ci.json';d=json.load(open(p));rows=[]
for obj in d['objects']:
 for h in obj['hits']:
  c=h['context'];n=h['needle']; pos=c.lower().find(n.lower());
  rows.append({'path':obj['path'],'offset':h['offset'],'needle':n,'context':c,'email_like':re.findall(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}',c),'pem':bool(re.search(r'BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY',c))})
# Retain every original context; show complete unique strings, removing only byte-identical duplicate context renderings.
json.dump(rows,open(os.environ['OUT']+'/reviewed-sweep-contexts.json','w'),indent=2)
print('objects',len(d['objects']),'hits',len(rows),'original_reported',d['total_hits'])
seen=set()
for r in rows:
 c=r['context']
 if c in seen:continue
 seen.add(c)
 print(r['path'],r['offset'],r['needle'],'email_like',r['email_like'],'pem',r['pem']);print(c)
print('unique_complete_contexts',len(seen))
PY
